title: Promotions Bulletin: Late Posting Multiplier for Residential Electricity Supply Sign-Up Credits
content:
Promotions bulletin, Residential Electricity Supply. A sign-up credit that reaches the bill after more cycles than the plan requires is scaled up.

**Rule.** The completed cycles beyond the plan's qualifying cycles are counted; with 3 or more cycles beyond, the plan sign-up credit is multiplied by the long late sign-up factor of 1.5; with 1 or 2 cycles beyond, by the short late sign-up factor of 1.25; with none beyond it is taken as it stands.

**Counting.** Completed cycles are the agreement's billing cycles that carry an on-peak or an all-hours energy charge line. The cycles beyond are the completed cycles less the plan's qualifying cycles, which are:

| Plan | Qualifying cycles |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 3 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 3 |

| Completed cycles on a plan qualifying at 3 | Cycles beyond | Plan sign-up credit is |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | taken as it stands |
| 4 | 1 | multiplied by 1.25 |
| 5 | 2 | multiplied by 1.25 |
| 6 | 3 | multiplied by 1.5 |
| 9 | 6 | multiplied by 1.5 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A plan sign-up credit of 50.00 USD on an agreement with 5 completed cycles becomes 62.50 USD.
